topics.headline: Next US CPI YoY to exceed 3.4
topics.summary: US CPI headline was 3.4% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-08-31. Prior month 3.4. US CPI index rose 0.3% from the prior month. US CPI food was 2.7% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-08-31. Prior month 3.0. US CPI shelter was 3.0% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-08-31. Prior month 3.2. US CPI energy was 3.3% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-08-31. Prior month 2.7.

gaps: No oil price on this feed. The energy row is the CPI energy index.
US CPI is monthly. The next print is the following month, not this week.

topics.headline: Next HICP > 3.2%
topics.summary: Latest print 3.2; energy surge to 14.3 from 10.3 and services at 3.0 imply next headline above 3.2.
